div.swg-settings [aria-label="Silverware Tags settings" aria-modal="true" role="dialog" tabindex="-1"]
p.swg-settings-subtitle "For the whole space: SilverBullet's configuration"

span.swg-settings-hint "SilverBullet's own pages (under Library/: libraries, the configuration, its API) are left out: their tags show nowhere, and no change touches them (a rename of a tag they use too renames it everywhere else); tags meta and under it (what SilverBullet tells templates and libraries by) are left out of the view too. Off: they show, the meta tags apart (Meta), and changes reach them."
span.swg-settings-name "List this page's tags first in the Tags panel"
span.swg-settings-hint "Tags used on the page you are viewing appear at the top. Off: all tags are sorted by name, folders first."

span.swg-settings-hint "Where a page has no tags yet: on one line in brackets (tags: [a, b]), as - lines, or as a string (tags: a, b; a tag with a space in it makes it [ ]). A page that has tags keeps their form."
span.swg-settings-hint "Rename a tag everywhere it is used; into a tag that exists, the two merge."
span.swg-settings-hint "The view by page: tags given to the pages picked in a tree of folders, and taken off them; the tags of the page you are on."
span.swg-settings-hint "Delete a tag everywhere it is used."
span.swg-settings-hint "The window's Cleanup: tags likely one (case, a separator, a plural, a typo) to merge, tags used on one page only."
span.swg-settings-hint "The tags as a panel beside the page (SilverBullet's navigator): a tag opens the Tags window, F2 renames it, a tag dragged under another moves it there."
span.swg-settings-hint "Your own operations on a tag, from a JS file of the space given with silverware.tags.defineOperations: a button of the tag, its changes reviewed first."
